DISCOVERY 612, NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. DEFENDANT/CROSS COMPLAINANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO INSPECTION DEMANDS IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO NO. 1. AS TO NOS. 2, 3, AND 6, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS IRRELEVANT. AS TO NO. 4, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS IRRELEVANT AND OVERLY BROAD. AS TO NO. 5, THE RESPONSE MUST BE SUPPLEMENTED TO COMPLY WITH 2031(G)(2). AS TO NO. 7, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS THE RESPONSE IS ADEQUATE. AS TO NO. 8, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. AS TO NO. 15, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS THE REQUEST IS IRRELEVANT AND OVERLY BROAD. AS TO NOS. 16 AND 17, THE MOTION IS DENIED. AS TO NO. 19, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. THE RESPONSE MUST AT LEAST IDENTIFY ALL RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS. AS TO NO. , THE MOTION IS DENIED AS THE REQUEST IS OVERLY BROAD. AS TO NOS. 25, 35, 37, AND 42, PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO PRODUCE AS AGREED. AS TO NOS. 27, 28, 29, 32, 39, AND 44, THE RESPONSE MUST BE SUPPLEMENTED TO COMPLY WITH 2031(G)(2). AS TO NOS. 33, 38, 41, 43, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS THE REQUEST IS IRRELEVANT. FURTHER RESPONSES AND PRODUCTION SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ALL REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
